text.p: These are the leading stories in the Lebanese press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Hizbollah vows suicide strikes to avenge Kfour. Three more civilians killed as five guerrillas are buried. Those were killed in Israeli roadside bombs after helicopter raid on Monday.

- Support rallies for MP Wakim as crackdown expected on opposition "incitement". A Beirut prosecutor has accused Najah Wakim of advocating armed rebellion and slandering Lebanese President Elias Hrawi.
- Egyptian trade balance is top of the agenda for meeting of supreme joint Lebanese-Egyptian Committee in Beirut.
- Israel drives Hizbollah towards an escalation (of violence) in south Lebanon.
- Parliament Speaker Berri: Lebanon needs Syria for economic and security reasons.
- Former speaker of parliament Hussein al-Husseini questions the government over squandering.
